info.name: Data Export Create Export Job API
info.description:
Export data in bulk from the Demandbase platform.

Authenticate using a bearer token. Pass a header like: `Authorization: {{bearer_token}}`

The part after 'Bearer' is your API token.
For instructions on generating API tokens, see the Generate and Manage API Key Set article at the Demandbase Help Center

item.name: Create export job (Account, Opportunity, Person, Activity, Campaign, and…

request.description: Creates a data export job for any supported entity type.
